integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: The data sources Minaly uses for your diagnostic.
integrations.stripeConfigError: The Stripe connection is temporarily unavailable (server configuration). Try again later or contact support.
integrations.stripeOauthError: The Stripe connection did not complete. Try again, and if the issue persists make sure you authorize the right account.
integrations.stripeReadOnly: Read-only access to your payments. This is the diagnostic’s primary source.
integrations.connectedPlatformsHelp: Connected platforms stay in one compact list. Use the refresh button to pull their latest data.
integrations.changeStripe: To switch Stripe accounts, disconnect and reconnect with the other account.
integrations.testMode: This Stripe account is in test mode: no sync will run to avoid mixing test and live data. Reconnect a live account.
integrations.testModeAdmin: Stripe account in test mode. It was synced with admin access. The data below is test data, not real data.
integrations.syncFailed: Sync failed. Disconnect and reconnect Stripe to try again.
integrations.callSoftwareHelp: Connect your call-booking tool to track booked calls automatically. iClosed or Calendly, either one (or both).
integrations.contentHelp: Connect Instagram and/or YouTube to see which posts and videos perform automatically.
